message: Fix broken anchor link in README.md (#464)

pr.title: Fix broken anchor link in README.md
pr.body:
Hi, maintainer-san 👋🏽
Thank you so much for developing such a great package!

I found a broken anchor link in the document and fixed it.
You can check it works the README in [this branch](https://github.com/ebi-yade/kong/tree/fix/update-readme).

diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index b2c023d..e3b9fe9 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -748,7 +748,7 @@ The default help output is usually sufficient, but if not there are two solution
 
 ### `Bind(...)` - bind values for callback hooks and Run() methods
 
-See the [section on hooks](#hooks-beforeresolve-beforeapply-afterapply-and-the-bind-option) for details.
+See the [section on hooks](#hooks-beforereset-beforeresolve-beforeapply-afterapply-and-the-bind-option) for details.
 
 ### Other options

explanation.what: README.md 内の hooks セクションへのアンカーリンクを `#hooks-beforeresolve-beforeapply-afterapply-and-the-bind-option` から `#hooks-beforereset-beforeresolve-beforeapply-afterapply-and-the-bind-option` に修正した。
explanation.why: PR本文にある通り、見出し文言の変更(おそらく BeforeReset フックの追加)でGitHub自動生成アンカーがずれ、リンクが壊れていたのを外部コントリビューターが修正した。
